title: Belgravia Rd, Athlone (near Heatherdale Primary, approx.): man, 31, shot dead, 6 Oct
summary: A 31-year-old man was shot dead in his vehicle on Belgravia Road, outside Heatherdale Primary School, on Tuesday morning 6 October after reportedly dropping his child at school. Police say he had multiple gunshot wounds,...
story: A 31-year-old man was shot dead in his vehicle on Belgravia Road, outside Heatherdale Primary School, on Tuesday morning 6 October after reportedly dropping his child at school. Police say he had multiple gunshot wounds, the shooting may be gang-related, and no arrests were made (Cape Town ETC, quoting FC van Wyk). A separate incident from the 10 Oct Belgravia pin.
